geo_days.question: Which vast Central Asian desert, whose name translates to 'Black Sand' in Turkic languages, covers nearly 70 percent of Turkmenistan's land area?
geo_days.fun_fact: Despite its name meaning 'Black Sand', the desert's dunes are actually golden-brown; 'black' originally referred to the rich, dark soil beneath the sand.
